item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are unequivocal: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are working for a ban because preventing that catastrophe must come first.

2. We will not accept a billion deaths as the price of technological progress. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe on at least that scale. We need a ban, not a faster race.

3. We believe humanity’s future is worth defending. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We demand policy that stops it from being built.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are working to ban superintelligence because we refuse to surrender humanity’s future. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We cannot treat those lives as an acceptable cost of innovation, or mistake a race toward disaster for progress. We need governments to stop that race with a binding, enforceable ban on developing superintelligence. Our task is to make the stakes unmistakable and turn public concern into political action. We are building the case for prevention, and we ask you to help us put human survival ahead of the pursuit of ever more powerful machines.
